title: Pay profiles & rules
intro: Pay profiles store base rates per employee; pay rules apply premiums, bonuses, and deductions by schedule or context.

sections.title: Pay profiles
steps: Maintain effective-dated base pay per employee.
Profiles feed payroll calculation for the active period.
sections.caption: Employee pay profiles list.

sections.title: Pay profile form
steps: Add or edit a profile for an employee.
Choose pay type and base rate with effective dates.
Save — payroll uses the profile valid on each work date.
sections.caption: Pay profile form.

fields.name: Employee
fields.effect: Staff member receiving this base compensation.

fields.name: Pay type
fields.effect: Hourly, salary, contract, commission, or mixed — drives payroll math.

fields.name: Base rate
fields.effect: Primary rate or salary amount in the chosen currency.

fields.name: Effective to
fields.effect: Optional end date when superseded by a newer profile.

sections.title: Pay rules
steps: Rules stack by priority with modes: allow, prevent, highest wins, or priority.
Target employees, departments, holidays, or time windows.
sections.caption: Labor pay rules list.

sections.title: Pay rule form
sections.intro: Each rule has one or more effects (multiplier, fixed bonus/deduction, percent bonus/deduction) and eligibility filters.
steps: Add or edit a rule with code and name.
Define effects and whether they apply to regular, overtime, or all hours.
Set date, time, weekday, and holiday filters.
Assign employees, departments, positions, or cost centers.
Save — the payroll engine evaluates rules when clocked hours are calculated.
sections.caption: Pay rule form with effects and filters.

fields.name: Priority
fields.effect: Order when stacking mode is priority.

fields.name: Stacking mode
fields.effect: How this rule interacts with other matching rules.

fields.name: Effects
fields.effect: Multiplier or amount adjustments applied to qualifying hours.

fields.name: Employee / department / position / cost center filters
fields.effect: Limits which staff the rule can affect.

fields.name: Date and time window
fields.effect: Optional start/end date and daily time range.

fields.name: Days of week / months
fields.effect: Restricts rule to selected calendar patterns.

fields.name: Holidays
fields.effect: Apply only on selected public holidays.

fields.name: After hours (day/week)
fields.effect: Triggers when daily or weekly hour thresholds are exceeded.
